quarterly_data.quarter: Nissan Chemical semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-11-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: First half of the fiscal year ending March 2026 (April 1 to September 30, 2025): net sales JPY 130,094 million (+JPY 11,908 million YoY), operating profit JPY 29,598 million (+JPY 1,253 million), ordinary profit JPY 29,788 million and net income attributable to owners of the parent JPY 22,827 million; net sales and every profit line beat both the prior-year half and the forecast announced in May (net sales JPY 121,900 million, operating profit JPY 28,300 million). Management cites strong semiconductor materials in Functional Materials. First-half R&D expenses were JPY 10,428 million.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 net sales JPY 130,094 million; operating profit JPY 29,598 million; net income JPY 22,827 million

quarterly_data.quarter: Nissan Chemical semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-11-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: Functional Materials segment, first half (April to September 2025): sales JPY 54,417 million and operating profit JPY 17,367 million (up JPY 2,838 million YoY), above the company's forecast. Sales of anti-reflective coatings for semiconductors (ARC) and multi-layer materials (OptiStack) rose sharply; SUNEVER (polyimide for LCD alignment layers) and SNOWTEX (polishing agents for electronic materials, surface treatments) sales also grew.
quarterly_data.figure: Functional Materials H1 sales JPY 54,417 million; operating profit JPY 17,367 million
